obligations.source_quote: Speech-Language Therapy: 30 minutes per session, 2 sessions per week, provided by a Licensed Speech-Language Pathologist in the therapy room, beginning September 8, 2026 and ending June 11, 2027.
Occupational Therapy: 45 minutes per session, 1 session per week, provided by a Licensed Occupational Therapist in the OT room, beginning September 8, 2026 and ending June 11, 2027.
Specialized Academic Instruction: 60 minutes daily, provided by an Education Specialist in the resource room, beginning September 8, 2026 and ending June 11, 2027.
Individual Counseling: 30 minutes per session, 1 session per month, provided by a School Psychologist in the counseling office, beginning September 8, 2026 and ending June 11, 2027.
